response.original_title: [!FAQS@Room!!] How do I add a room on a MSC Cruise?
response.overview: To add a Room to an existing MSC cruise booking +1-866-829-1280 , please contact Customer Service at a +1-866-829-1280 (US) or 44-204-586-5316 (UK) for assistance with checking state Room availability and updating the reservation. A representative can guide you through the available options and provide 1-(866)-829-1280 (US) or & +44-204-586-5316(UK) information about applicable rates, Room categories, and booking requirements. If the reservation was made through a travel advisor, please contact the advisor for further assistance. To add another Room on a MSC cruise, call Customer Support directly at 1-(866)-829-1280 (US) or reach out to your travel advisor. Because each Room requires its own booking, an agent will create a separate reservation at current @+1-866-829-1280(US) or +44-204-586-5316 market rates. Be sure to request that all booking numbers be officially linked so your entire group enjoys shared dining times and table seating together.
